results.prediction: Iran war ceasefire or major escalation
results.description: Iran has rejected the US 15-point ceasefire proposal and denies engaging in direct negotiations, calling Trump's claims of talks "deceitful." results.prediction: Strait of Hormuz full shipping restoration
results.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed with severe disruptions continuing into late March 2026. Iran maintains tight control over the waterway, allowing selective passage for Chinese, Indian, Pakistani, and Malaysian vessels while approximately 2,000 ships from other nations remain stranded. Full shipping restoration has not been achieved.

results.prediction: Schedule Policy/Career legal challenge succeeds or fails
results.description: Schedule Policy/Career took effect March 9, 2026, reclassifying approximately 50,000 federal career positions to at-will employment. Federal employee unions have renewed their lawsuit challenging the policy, with the NTEU filing an amended complaint on March 17, 2026. No final court ruling on the legal challenge has been issued yet.

results.prediction: Mojtaba Khamenei confirmed as Supreme Leader of Iran
results.description: Mojtaba Khamenei was officially confirmed as Iran's third Supreme Leader by the Assembly of Experts on March 8, 2026, following his father Ali Khamenei's assassination during the 2026 Iran war.
